seeds.why: Pre-#1272 remedy: retain_disown's method tells the operator to drop the disowned table and leaves out the DELETE of its pgpm.part row, so typed as logged it leaves the row attached and anchored to a relation that is gone, every later retire() and retain() logs fail_retain_identity for the range, and status().retain_drop_failures climbs for good. One site, the DELETE clause of the remedy. tests/339 parts A and B catch it.
